entities.name: Frankie Peanuts
entities.description: A figure not to be crossed, lest one end up sleeping with the merfolk.

entities.name: Mongo
entities.description: A creature troubled by fleas and by a family of goblins living behind his left ear.

entities.name: Cornelian
entities.description: An inventor with a hundred failed patent applications who designed a gnome with scoops for hands.

entities.name: Richard Garfield, Ph.D.
entities.description: A figure who spoke Magic into being.

entities.name: Spike, Tournament Grinder
entities.description: A tournament player always ready with a response.

entities.name: Infinity Elemental
entities.description: An elemental so infinite that its flavor text recurses endlessly.

entities.description: A card the Old Fogey counts as part of real Magic.

entities.name: Pippa, Duchess of Dice

events.summary: Cornelian, after a hundred failed patent applications, designs a gnome with scoops for hands to deliver ice cream.
events.quote: He immediately designed a gnome with scoops for hands.

events.summary: Richard Garfield proclaims the creation of Magic.
events.quote: And yea he doth spake: "Let there be Magic."
